Chapter 869: Chapter 12 Me Against the Galaxy Master? (Subscribe Please)

Several days later.

Lin Yuan was about to arrive at the Human Civilization Alliance War Base.

Actually, if it weren’t for intentionally searching along the way,

to see if he could find traces of other Tenth Rankings from Different Races, and possibly harvest a few more ultimate weapons,

Lin Yuan estimated that he would have already reached the warbase.

“Those Tenth Ranking from Different Races have also learned to be smart…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. Ever since he killed nine Eleventh Ranks of the Prison Tribe and Insect Race, among whom three carried ultimate weapons,

in the core zone battlefield, the Eleventh Ranks of the major different races had become much more low-key, not only staying away from the area where Lin Yuan was last seen, but also avoiding as much as possible any battles with other races.

Without the space-time fluctuations from battles, Lin Yuan could only detect the traces of different races within tens of millions of miles at most, which is a drop in the ocean compared to the vast core zone battlefield.

“Next, I need to find an opportunity and wait until those Tenth Rankings of Different Races are all gathered together before making a move.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Only by doing so could he reap the maximum reward. If Lin Yuan revealed his true strength too early, those Tenth Rankings from Different Races would probably not dare to gather together, but would be dispersed in corners of the core zone battlefield, engaging in guerrilla warfare.

After all, Lin Yuan’s outward strength wasn’t unbeatable at the moment; at least a few of the strongest Eleventh Ranks from various peak powers were confident they could handle him.

This was also the illusion Lin Yuan had created by taking action several times.

…

Outside the Human Civilization Alliance War Base,

dozens of figures were already waiting.

All of them were Eleventh Rank Evolvers from the nine Evolution Towers.

“A few days ago, the Galaxy Master struck again, killing nine Eleventh Ranks of the Insect Race and Prison Tribe.”

“How terrifying, how many years has the Galaxy Master been cultivating?”

“The strongest genius in the history of our Human Civilization? I guess in the history of the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, there has never been a genius comparable to the Galaxy Master.”

…

The dozens of Eleventh Rank Evolvers were quietly discussing this as they received news that the Galaxy Master was about to arrive and had been waiting here early on.

Those who could stand here, the Eleventh Rank Evolvers, were basically all Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers, hardly lacking in pride. Yet facing the Galaxy Master’s fierce achievements, all they felt was admiration.

Killing Eleventh Ranks holding ultimate weapons was an entirely different concept from defeating Eleventh Ranks holding ultimate weapons.

Even though there were a few Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers on the field who, by relying on treasures bestowed by the supreme powerhouses, could forcefully kill Eleventh Ranks holding ultimate weapons,

how many years had the Galaxy Master been cultivating?

When they were at the age of the Galaxy Master, they were still playing around at the fifth or sixth rank.

Meanwhile, the Galaxy Master was already wreaking havoc in this super-large warbase in space of intense warfare.

Just as the numerous Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers were rapidly exchanging information,

a figure emerged silently in front of everyone.

“Galaxy Master.”

“Greetings to the Galaxy Master.”

One after another, the Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers immediately looked at Lin Yuan with ardent eyes.

“Is the warbase all set up?” Lin Yuan glanced down. The arrangement of the warbase hadn’t been done by Lin Yuan, but by the Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers from various Evolution Towers.

Of course, as the supreme commander of the Human Civilization Alliance in this battlefield, Lin Yuan had the ultimate control over the super-large battlefield.

“Yes.”

“It’s almost ready.”

The leading Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver spoke with a smile. His name was Xuanyuan You, from the Xuanyuan Evolution Tower. If not for Lin Yuan, he would likely be the supreme commander of this battlefield.

Lin Yuan looked at the Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers and said, “I haven’t been involved in many wars against different races, the main problems on the battlefield still rely on all of you.”

“The Galaxy Master is being modest.”

Xuanyuan You a was slightly stunned and couldn’t help but speak, “With the strength of the Galaxy Master, having the confidence to influence the outcome of the entire war, it is us who rely on the Galaxy Master.”

“What’s the current situation?”

Lin Yuan inquired.

“The current state of the super-large battlefield rarely sees local conflicts; everyone is preparing for a full-scale war.” Xuanyuan You’s face showed a trace of amusement, “This should be due to the deterrence of the Galaxy Master.”

Normally, the strongest Eleventh Ranks from various peak clans, although capable of suppressing ordinary Eleventh Ranks with ultimate weapons, generally wouldn’t make a move.

But due to Lin Yuan’s influence, those strongest Eleventh Ranks began to take action successively, causing most Eleventh Ranks to dare not fight outside, and instead hide in the warbases, waiting for the full-scale war to come.

The full-scale war refers to the decisive battle where the twelve peak clan forces converge the vast majority of their power.

Within the full-scale war, the strongest Eleventh Ranks generally face counterparts of the same level.

Ordinary Eleventh Ranks face ordinary Eleventh Ranks, and there won’t be scenes of the strongest Eleventh Ranks picking on ordinary Eleventh Ranks.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded, no wonder he hardly felt any battle fluctuations along the way.

Not only was he making moves, but the strongest Eleventh Ranks from other peak clan forces were also taking action.

“Alright.”

“I won’t intervene with the specific arrangements of the war. When the full-scale war begins, just call me.”

Lin Yuan said.

Intervene with war arrangements? It requires a great deal of immersion in war experience, and even if Lin Yuan had the ability, he didn’t want to waste the time.

“Sure.”

Xuanyuan You and the other Eleventh Level Perfected ones were slightly relieved.

Although Lin Yuan was extremely dazzling, in terms of war preparations, it was not just about having strong cultivation talent that counted, but also relied on a keen grasp of the battle situation.

They were truly worried that Lin Yuan, being overly confident, would misjudge the war situation, leading to a scenario where the Human Civilization Alliance suffered a crushing defeat.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared once again.

He appeared at the most central location of the battlefield base.

This place was also the control center of the entire war base.

Lin Yuan could freely control every detail of the war base from here.

“Did the Galaxy Master leave just like that?”

“Not discussing with us how to deal with the eleventh ranks of the other peak clans?”

…

Dozens of Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers looked at each other; this was the first time they had seen such a ‘nonchalant’ commander of the battlefield.

“Alright.”

“Since the Galaxy Master does not wish to get involved with the war arrangements, then let me take charge. Once we’ve discussed the results, we’ll present them to the Galaxy Master for a decision.”

Xuanyuan You glanced around; he held great prestige within the Human Civilization Eleventh Rank circle and was very persuasive.

Furthermore, Lin Yuan’s deliberate delegation of authority made him feel quite relaxed.

Sometimes, whether the opponent is strong or not is not the key factor; what’s crucial is whether the commander can clearly judge the situation.

As a commander, although Lin Yuan did not make any arrangements, he also did not meddle at will, which put Xuanyuan You at ease.

…

War Base Control Room.

Rather than calling it a control room, it would be better to say it was a vast world.

“This war base is fundamentally a large-scale Twelfth Rank fortress, much more important than ordinary supreme weapons.”

Lin Yuan, controlling the entire war base, pondered deeply.

Even with the foundation of human civilization, there’s only such a base; one can imagine how terrifying this war base is.

“The war bases of the other ten peak clan forces are probably similar…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself; to break through such a terrifying war fortress, even if he exerted all his strength, would be difficult to achieve in a short amount of time.

“Nevertheless, if they’re all hiding in their war bases, then wait until full-scale war breaks out before taking action.”

Lin Yuan thought silently, once full-scale war commenced, the vast majority of Eleventh Rank beings from different clans would appear on the battlefield. That would be the best opportunity for Lin Yuan to capture them all at once.

“For now… continue cultivating…”

Lin Yuan gazed through the control room at the vast and colossal Battlefields of Different Races.

The essence of this colossal Battlefield of Different Races is a stable world created by many supreme beings, converging the vast origins of Space-Time Rule.

Observing this colossal battlefield was equivalent to observing the insights of various supreme beings regarding space-time, combined with the Secret Skill “Milky Way.”

For Lin Yuan’s understanding of space and stepping into the pinnacle of Sixth Realm, this could be of great benefit.

[Your perceptiveness defies the heavens. Observing the colossal battlefield enhances your understanding of space-time…]

For a moment, numerous insights on space-time flooded his mind.

“Space-time… originally one entity, why speak of fusion at all?”

“To perceive space-time, one shouldn’t approach it from the perspective of fusing them, but from the depths of one’s heart, seeing them as originating from the same source.”

The more Lin Yuan observed the colossal battlefield, the more bursts of inspiration surged within him.

The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule attracts most strong beings’ attention to ‘fusion,’ but in reality, space-time does not need to fuse; they are inherently unified.

“Milky Way…”

With a mere thought from Lin Yuan, the surface of his body started to ripple with a space-time ‘Milky Way.’ This secret technique, in the most straightforward and understandable manner, articulated the essence of the Sixth Realm and even the Seventh Realm of space-time.

Lin Yuan’s realization of the Sixth Realm of space-time in the Boundless Void owed a great deal to the Secret Skill “Milky Way.”

…

Tianyu Clan War Base.

Tianyu Meng sat high on his throne, wearing a halo of sanctity, and looked down upon the numerous Eleventh Rank Godlords below him.

On both sides of Tianyu Meng were two slightly smaller thrones, occupied by the other two strongest Eleventh Rank members of the Tianyu Clan.

“Next, let’s discuss how to deal with the Human Civilization Alliance.”

Tianyu Meng looked around slowly, speaking at a measured pace.

“The Human Civilization Alliance’s evolvers who can be called the strongest eleventh ranks, Xuanyuan You should be counted as one, and that Galaxy Master probably too.”

The one with a head full of golden hair on Tianyu Meng’s left was also a strongest Eleventh Rank of the Tianyu Clan.

His name was ‘Qu Li Xiao,’ a direct descendant of the Tianyu Clan’s second progenitor.

Amongst the many Eleventh Rank strong beings of the Tianyu Grand Alliance, Qu Li Xiao was definitely the strongest, second only to Tianyu Meng.

The artifact he carried, even though not as formidable as Tianyu Meng’s halo of sanctity, was not to be overlooked, its lethality surpassed that of supreme weapons.

“Xuanyuan You… was the disciple of the Xuanyuan Supreme of human civilization; Xuanyuan Supreme had not yet struck at the ultimate when he became his Disciple. This time, Xuanyuan Supreme should have bestowed a treasure, likely very powerful.”

When Tianyu Meng reached this point, he paused for a moment and continued, “In that case, I will handle Xuanyuan You.”

“As for the Galaxy Master, I’ll leave it to you, ‘Qu Li Xiao.'”

Tianyu Meng looked at ‘Qu Li Xiao,’ and said.

“Me dealing with the Galaxy Master?” A smile appeared on Qu Li Xiao’s face as he confidently said, “No problem.”
